name: Koh Rong Island
description: Cambodia's premier tropical island paradise with over 43 kilometers of powdery white beaches, turquoise bays, dense rainforest, and magical bioluminescent plankton tours at night.
description_km: កោះឋានសួគ៌ធម្មជាតិដ៏ធំរបស់កម្ពុជា ដែលមានឆ្នេរខ្សាច់សស្អាតជាង ៤៣ គីឡូម៉ែត្រ ទឹកសមុទ្រថ្លាយ៉ង់ និងពន្លឺប្លង់តុងភ្លឺផ្លេកៗនារាត្រី។
price: Speed Ferry ~$25 round-trip from Sihanoukville mainland
best_time: December to May (Calm seas & sunny days)
accessibility: Moderate (speedboats, island piers and walking along sand)
transportation: Speed Ferry from Sihanoukville Autonomous Port (45 min)
verified_source: Preah Sihanouk Provincial Department of Tourism

name: Koh Rong Sanloem
name_km: កោះរ៉ុងសន្លឹម
description: The quieter, more intimate sister island to Koh Rong, featuring the stunning crescent-shaped Saracen Bay with shallow crystal-clear waters, Lazy Beach, and eco-bungalows.
description_km: កោះប្អូនដ៏ស្ងប់ស្ងាត់ មានឆ្នេរខ្សាច់រាងអឌ្ឍចន្ទ (Saracen Bay) ទឹកសមុទ្ររាក់ថ្លាដូចកញ្ចក់ និងផ្ទះលំហែកាយបែបអេកូឡូស៊ី។
verified_source: Preah Sihanouk Provincial Department of Tourism

name: Otres Beach & Ochheuteal
name_km: ឆ្នេរអូរត្រេះ និង អូរឈើទាល
description: Sihanoukville's mainland coastal stretch offering fine sand, gentle waves, seaside restaurants, water sports, and sunset lounges.
description_km: ឆ្នេរសមុទ្រលើដីគោកក្នុងក្រុងព្រះសីហនុ ដែលមានខ្សាច់ម៉ត់ រលកស្ងប់ និងហាងអាហារសមុទ្រស្រស់ៗជាច្រើន។
accessibility: Very Good (paved road and beachfront promenade)
verified_source: Preah Sihanouk Provincial Department of Tourism
